picks.rationale: Flow Studio's 3D Editor + Canvas hands filmmakers real blocking, camera and performance control over generative shots — the most directly actionable tool release in the pool.
picks.excerpt: Autodesk's Flow Studio adds 3D Editor + Canvas, letting filmmakers block shots, cameras and performance directly in 3D while AI handles final rendering. The release lays groundwork for Maya and DCC integrations and agent-driven directing.

picks.rationale: Seedance 2.5 landing inside Runway puts 30-second single-shot generation and 3D camera blockouts in a workspace editors already use — an availability change you can act on today.
picks.excerpt: Runway announces ByteDance's Seedance 2.5 is now available inside its platform, putting 30-second single-shot generation and 3D camera blockouts alongside Runway's own tools in one filmmaking workspace.

picks.rationale: Bootleg 'The Office' and 'Friends' from MiniMax H3 shows how cheaply a video model now reproduces a show's look and cast — a concrete new front in IP enforcement.
picks.excerpt: Bootleg 'The Office' and 'Friends' clips generated with China's MiniMax H3 are going viral outside China, reminding studios how hard IP policing is when a video model can reproduce a show's look, cast and staging on demand.

picks.rationale: A working VFX supervisor's read on which SIGGRAPH 2026 neural rendering, gaussian splat and AI animation demos actually survive contact with a production pipeline.
picks.excerpt: VFX supervisor Todd Sheridan Perry gives an honest, artist-side read on SIGGRAPH 2026 in LA — what the neural rendering, gaussian splat and AI-assisted animation demos actually mean for production pipelines.

picks.rationale: Roth denying then admitting generative AI in 'Ice Cream Man' is a live case study in how hybrid animation gets disclosed — and what happens when audiences spot it first.
picks.excerpt: Eli Roth first described the animated sequences in 'Ice Cream Man' as traditionally made, then admitted generative AI was used in "a very small portion" after viewers spotted AI shots at early screenings. A case study in disclosure norms for hybrid animation.
